mechanism_narrative: The Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is currently at 220.252, which is above 200. Historical data shows that when CPIAUCSL is above 200, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases. Therefore, we predict positive returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 200 but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) combined with low housing starts (HOUST < 550.0) indicates a recessionary environment where the market is undervalued, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.0 AND HOUST < 550.0 but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to the risk of monetary tightening and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 225 but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 550.0) indicate weak demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness. This weakness often leads to policy responses that boost equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 550.0 but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) combined with low housing starts (HOUST < 550.0) indicates a weakening economy, which is a buying opportunity for the market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 AND HOUST < 550.0 but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 370000.0 indicates weak demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness. This weakness often leads to policy responses that boost equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 370000.0 but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (measured as the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) indicates an imminent tightening of monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS_1m_change > 0.1% but 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of cases.
